answer: In an "island" of decentralized systems, where "echo" chambers of autonomous agents operate, ensuring Sybil resistance is paramount. By imposing a copper fast lock-up period for stake validators, any attacker attempting to create multiple pseudonymous identities incurs prohibitive costs, thereby diminishing their expected utility. This mechanism, which aligns incentives through long-term commitment, sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by mathematically preventing a majority of malicious nodes from overwhelming the system.
